testCases.title: Verify that the contact API rejects invalid messages and accepts a boundary-length message
preconditions: The contact endpoint POST /messages is reachable without authentication

steps.action: Send a contact message with a malformed email address
steps.expected: HTTP 422; the validation error names the email field

steps.action: Send a contact message without a subject
steps.expected: HTTP 422; the validation error names the subject field

steps.action: Send a contact message of 251 characters
steps.expected: HTTP 422; the validation error names the message field

steps.action: Send a contact message of exactly 250 characters
steps.expected: HTTP 201; the response echoes the submitted message and has status NEW

steps.action: Send a contact message of 49 characters
steps.expected: HTTP 422; the validation error names the message field

testCases.notes: Step 5 follows AC-2. Whether the 50-character minimum is enforced by the service or only by the form is not stated in the story.

testCases.title: Verify that an authenticated customer's contact message is stored exactly as submitted
preconditions: A customer account exists and a bearer token for it is available

steps.action: Send a contact message as the signed-in customer
steps.expected: HTTP 201; the response contains an id and status NEW

steps.action: Read the stored message back by id as the same customer
steps.expected: HTTP 200; subject and message are identical to what was sent; status is NEW

testCases.notes: Read-back is only possible for the authenticated sender; anonymous callers cannot read messages.

testCases.title: Verify that a visitor can send a message through the contact form
preconditions: The visitor is not signed in

steps.action: Fill in first name, last name, email address, choose a subject, and enter a message of at least 50 characters
steps.data: Jane / Doe / jane@example.com / Customer service / <valid 60 character message>
steps.expected: All fields show the entered values; no validation error is displayed
The form is replaced by the confirmation "Thanks for your message! We will contact you shortly."

testCases.title: Verify that the contact form blocks invalid input before sending
preconditions: The visitor is not signed in

steps.expected: A "<Field> is required" error appears next to first name, last name, email address, subject, and message; no request is sent to the server

steps.action: Fill every field but enter a message of 49 characters, then send the form
steps.expected: The error "Message must be minimal 50 characters" is shown next to the message field; no request is sent to the server

testCases.notes: "No request is sent" must be observed on the network, not inferred from the absence of the confirmation.
